body: 7 Nov 2026, found on the owner's A35 and fixed in open PRs (not merged: checks blocked, P0-16): (1) a song the server cannot find ("Lofi For Focus") left the Play button spinning for ever after "Couldn't play" and never said why: the engine gave up without stopping the platform player, and the server's reason (404 song_unavailable) never reached the app (audit B-117, PR #243, docs/33 PB-25/PB-F11); (2) pressing an artist name opened a page that was a bare spinner with no Back, for 8% of songs (those tagged "A, B": audit B-118, PR #244); (3) only one artist of a song by several could be pressed (B-120, PR #246). This item stays "built": the fixes are not merged and not walked on the release-candidate pair.
